scientific_integrity: The universal formula is proved symbolically from the published planar active-region identity and an exact cap-area computation. The bundled finite clipping program is used only as an independent indexing and numerical sanity check, not as proof for infinitely many polygons.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats Euclidean regular odd polygons only. It neither establishes the global maximum of the average-normal invariant nor produces a body with value greater than 8. Historical originality retains a residual risk from older unindexed computations; the inaccessible 1993 source was not used for a whole-document negative claim.
title: Exact average-normal deficit of regular odd polygons
